id: Back to the Future Part II (1989)

vibe.verdict: Cafe 80s is the right place and most of the 2015 props are on the menu, but the tone is a plain diner when the film is all frantic, funny paradoxes.
missing: Griff goading Marty by calling him chicken (Cafe 80s)
The Western Union letter from Doc in 1885
The 1955 dance and Biff's manure truck crash
ideas: Swap 'Crispy chicken tenders' note for 'Nobody calls Marty chicken', from Griff's goading at Cafe 80s.
Swap 'Cafe 80's milkshake' note for 'Great Scott! It's thick'.
Swap the 'Overheard at the counter' wink for 'Burn the almanac. Pass the pie'.
Swap 'Ask about today's pie' footer for 'Western Union delivery, 1955. Letter inside'.
changed: Doc's note opens with Great Scott
Last wink: Griff calling Marty chicken (Pleasure Paradise stays on the blue plate)
